reviewed_by: Delegated Task B coding agent: source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view of retail igi.exe (entry 0x004A50F5) and the bound Radare2 artifacts; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/model/iff_chunk_tree.cpp hashes to 69b2e71f88a595c3cfcccf5b40df8c3ca54412b41ff46f09a0585175dc050ace. The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja view (decompile and block/edge sets) for this review, and the bound Radare2 artifact is unchanged. The candidate object and its linked-image symbol were then compared to that reconstruction. This review supersedes the earlier report that did not use the seven required semantic check names or that described the retail child link offset incorrectly.

candidate_function.summary: IffChunk_FindByTag: sibling walk; FORM marker test on tag; form-type match at +0x14; recursive descent into the first child; non-FORM match on form_type.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail 0x00517890 (Binary Ninja Terrain_BuildMipMaps_5) is the find-by-tag walk over a chunk list: it walks the sibling chain, matches the FORM marker and the tag/form-type fields, and recurses into a form's first child. The candidate IffChunk_FindByTag performs the same walk and returns the same selected node.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail signature void**(void** arg1, int32_t arg2): arg1 is the list head read at +0x00/+0x08/+0x10/+0x14, arg2 is the 32-bit tag. Candidate IffChunk_FindByTag(IffChunkNode*, std::uint32_t) has the same two-argument cdecl layout, with the POINTER typed and the tag unsigned.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: The FORM marker constant 0x464F524D and the node field offsets +0x00 (next), +0x08 (first child), +0x10 (tag), +0x14 (form type) are reproduced exactly; there is no scaling or unit conversion in this routine.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Retail reads raw void** node fields at +0x00/+0x08/+0x10/+0x14 and returns a raw node address; the candidate reads typed IffChunkNode members in the same order and returns a typed node pointer. The port's IffChunkNode is filled by the host parser in the retail order, so the selection semantics are preserved even though the node representation is owned by the port.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail makes one self-recursive call when a matching form has a first child, and no other calls. The candidate makes the same single self-recursive call and writes no memory.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns the selected node pointer or null; every loop exit and the recursive not-found path are covered. The candidate returns the selected node or nullptr on the same paths.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point value, constant or comparison appears in the retail function or the candidate.

checks.name: addressability
checks.detail: Present with external linkage (nm type T) at 0x004232A0 in build-clean-win32/igi1.exe, 4 direct call sites, caller IffSkeleton_Read.

checks.name: port_only_divergence
checks.detail: Port-only divergence: C++ linkage and typed IffChunkNode pointers instead of raw void**. This changes symbol naming and tree representation, not the walk. No codegen change was made or needed for addressability.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail is void**(void**, int32_t) over raw links; the candidate is IffChunkNode*(IffChunkNode*, std::uint32_t). Two cdecl arguments and a 32-bit pointer return are preserved; only pointer typing and signedness of the tag differ.

limitations: The port holds the tree by value/unique_ptr; raw retail link addresses are not reproduced.
The differential uses generated graphs, not original game assets.
No live paired retail/candidate game-process capture exists; STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED is the maximum supported status.
The CFG agreement cited is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image, not a candidate-vs-retail isomorphism score.

port_only_divergences.detail: retail symbol name Iff_FindFormChunk -> candidate mangled IffChunk_FindByTag; codegen unchanged.
